name: Andrej Karpathy
description: A prominent computer scientist known for his work in deep learning and computer vision, formerly Director of AI at Tesla and a founding member of OpenAI.

name: Yann LeCun
description: A computer scientist and Turing Award winner known for his work in convolutional neural networks and deep learning, currently Chief AI Scientist at Meta.

name: Andrew Ng
description: A global leader in AI, co-founder of Coursera and Google Brain, and adjunct professor at Stanford University.
